messages:
maria: Hey folks — can I get a short admin window (30m) to pull telemetry from model-inference-prod-3? We saw a tail-latency spike yesterday and need to extract traces and request metadata from S3 to correlate. Will only need temporary sudo on telemetry-prod cluster + S3 read for s3://redwood-telemetry/2026-03. I plan to redact user identifiers before analysis. Pinging @ajay and @sec-team-bot for approvals. TL;DR: 30m break-glass to run a one-off data pull and redaction script.

ajay: Can you add a one-line justification, exact window (start/end in UTC), and the exact commands you intend to run? Also confirm whether the files contain PII (names/emails) or just user_ids — we need to know redaction scope. If possible run against a copied subset in staging first.

maria: Justification: Investigating 99.9th percentile token-level latency regressions after the last kernel update. Window: 2026-03-20 14:00–14:30 UTC (30m). Commands (one-off):

```
# copy a single shard locally, redact user_id to null and extract relevant fields
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-telemetry/2026-03/part-000.gz ./
zcat part-000.gz | jq '.events[] | {ts, model, latency_ms, request_path, user_id: null}' > redacted-part-000.json
```

Data contents: mostly numeric telemetry + opaque user_id strings. No free-text user-submitted content, but user_id is a stable identifier so we'll null it out before storing. We'll also keep the audit logs / session recorded. I'll create a temporary workspace with limited retention and delete local copies after analysis. I'll also file a JIRA and attach the script.

sec-team-bot: Checklist: 1) Provide JIRA ticket link before elevation. 2) Use ephemeral-role with scoped S3 read + kube exec limited to telemetry namespace. 3) Session recording enabled and audit logs retained for 90 days. 4) Confirm no off-network transfer.

maria: JIRA created: INF-2389. I set ephemeral-role request in IAM with scope s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-telemetry/2026-03/* and kube access limited to namespace telemetry-prod. No external transfer; analysis happens on a locked analysis host.

sam: FYI — quick policy note: if you plan to store any derived artifacts, ensure the storage bucket is tagged as internal and lifecycle set to 30d. Approving on condition of the ephemeral role and session recording. Please add me as a session watcher. I'll grant a temporary break-glass approval for 30 minutes starting at 2026-03-20T14:00:00Z. @maria confirm you'll null user_id as in the script before any diff/grep.

maria: Confirmed. I'll null user_id and won't pull any other fields. I'll also run the script on a single shard first and paste the head output in the JIRA for quick review.

ajay: Cool — I'll coordinate the role grant and attach the CloudTrail session link here when done. Reminder: avoid running broad queries like `jq '.events[]'` without the filter; that can produce huge local files.

sec-approvals: Approval granted by sam for maria. Scope: ephemeral-role telemetry-read-only (s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket on redwood-telemetry/2026-03/* + kube:exec in telemetry namespace). Window: 2026-03-20T14:00:00Z — 2026-03-20T14:30:00Z. Audit: session recorded, CloudTrail link: https://console.aws.example/ct/ABCDEF (obfuscated). Tag: security:approved. Reaction: :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all — I'll start at 14:00 UTC and post the JIRA link and the sample head output after the shard test. Will delete local copies within the window and update the ticket when complete. :eyes:

ajay: Role is provisioned and session link posted above. Monitoring network ACLs and will revoke early if anything suspicious shows up.

sam: Noted. Closing approval thread — thanks for following the checklist.
